parts.part_title: The Art of Really Knowing Someone
Vulnerability and the Courage to Be Seen
The Science and Experience of Closeness

experiences.title: The Stranger Across From Me
experiences.part_title: The Art of Really Knowing Someone
experiences.source_premise: Pretend you have just met. Interview one another as fascinating strangers and discover how familiarity can hide curiosity.

experiences.title: The Life You’ve Never Told Me
experiences.part_title: The Art of Really Knowing Someone
experiences.source_premise: Share a significant episode of life the other has never heard in detail, including turning points and formative relationships.

experiences.title: The Five Defining Moments
experiences.part_title: The Art of Really Knowing Someone
experiences.source_premise: Identify five experiences that fundamentally changed who you are and explain their ongoing influence.

experiences.title: Before I Was Me
experiences.part_title: The Art of Really Knowing Someone
experiences.source_premise: Explore childhood personalities, family dynamics, early dreams, and parts of your younger selves still present today.

experiences.title: The Things Nobody Thinks to Ask
experiences.part_title: The Art of Really Knowing Someone
experiences.source_premise: Ask unusual, specific questions about beliefs, habits, memories, preferences, and private thoughts.

experiences.title: The Museum of Me
experiences.part_title: The Art of Really Knowing Someone
experiences.source_premise: Curate an imaginary museum of objects, people, songs, and events representing your life; give your partner a tour.

experiences.title: The Opinion I Changed
experiences.part_title: The Art of Really Knowing Someone
experiences.source_premise: Discuss convictions you once held strongly, how they changed, and what that reveals about growth.

experiences.title: The Secret Biography
experiences.part_title: The Art of Really Knowing Someone
experiences.source_premise: Write a revealing biography of your contradictions, motivations, vulnerabilities, and less visible qualities.

experiences.title: The Uncomfortable Truth
experiences.part_title: Vulnerability and the Courage to Be Seen
experiences.source_premise: Willingly share something difficult to admit, while the listener receives it without judgment or immediate repair.

experiences.title: The Fear Beneath the Fear
experiences.part_title: Vulnerability and the Courage to Be Seen
experiences.source_premise: Explore successive layers beneath a fear to reveal underlying needs, experiences, or beliefs.

experiences.title: What I Don’t Show the World
experiences.part_title: Vulnerability and the Courage to Be Seen
experiences.source_premise: Describe parts of yourself you hide from others and what would make them safe to reveal.

experiences.title: The Permission Slip
experiences.part_title: Vulnerability and the Courage to Be Seen
experiences.source_premise: Write yourself permission to be imperfect, playful, uncertain, ambitious, needy, or emotionally open.

experiences.title: Confession Without Consequence
experiences.part_title: Vulnerability and the Courage to Be Seen
experiences.source_premise: Offer a chosen embarrassment, regret, insecurity, or harmless private truth for curious listening; this is not immunity for harmful behavior.

experiences.title: The Part of Me That Still Hurts
experiences.part_title: Vulnerability and the Courage to Be Seen
experiences.source_premise: Discuss an old disappointment or rejection that still has emotional weight, focusing on understanding.

experiences.title: When I Feel Small
experiences.part_title: Vulnerability and the Courage to Be Seen
experiences.source_premise: Describe what makes you feel inadequate or overlooked and which reassurances genuinely help.

experiences.title: No Armor Tonight
experiences.part_title: Vulnerability and the Courage to Be Seen
experiences.source_premise: Set aside habitual jokes, defensiveness, and impressive answers in favor of straightforward emotional honesty.

experiences.title: Four Minutes of Forever
experiences.part_title: The Science and Experience of Closeness
experiences.source_premise: Share four minutes of comfortable, uninterrupted eye contact, noticing what arises without needing to talk.

experiences.title: The Silent Conversation
experiences.part_title: The Science and Experience of Closeness
experiences.source_premise: Communicate for an agreed period only by expression, movement, and gestures.

experiences.title: Breathe With Me
experiences.part_title: The Science and Experience of Closeness
experiences.source_premise: Sit together and let your breathing settle naturally, noticing shared presence.

experiences.title: The Listening Experiment
experiences.part_title: The Science and Experience of Closeness
experiences.source_premise: Take turns speaking uninterrupted about something meaningful while the other listens and reflects back.

experiences.title: The Trust Walk
experiences.part_title: The Science and Experience of Closeness
experiences.source_premise: Guide a partner with closed or covered eyes through a safe space; practice clear direction and trust.

experiences.title: The Language of Touch
experiences.part_title: The Science and Experience of Closeness
experiences.source_premise: Explore welcome nonsexual forms of touch and discover which create comfort and affection.

experiences.title: The Sixty-Second Embrace
experiences.part_title: The Science and Experience of Closeness
experiences.source_premise: Share an unhurried, mutually comfortable embrace and notice how deliberate affection differs from routine.

experiences.title: The Presence Challenge
experiences.part_title: The Science and Experience of Closeness
experiences.source_premise: Remove phones, chores, and other distractions for a dedicated stretch of undivided attention.

experiences.title: What Loving Me Actually Looks Like
experiences.part_title: Love, Affection, and Feeling Chosen
experiences.source_premise: Compare the exact behaviors, words, and gestures that make each person feel loved.

experiences.title: The Appreciation Avalanche
experiences.part_title: Love, Affection, and Feeling Chosen
experiences.source_premise: Exchange increasingly specific appreciations until you move beyond the obvious.

experiences.title: The Moment I Knew
experiences.part_title: Love, Affection, and Feeling Chosen
experiences.source_premise: Tell stories of when the other started to matter more, or closeness deepened.

experiences.title: Instructions for Loving Me
experiences.part_title: Love, Affection, and Feeling Chosen
experiences.source_premise: Write a playful personal owner’s manual, including emotional needs, warning signs, and useful maintenance.

experiences.title: The Reassurance Menu
experiences.part_title: Love, Affection, and Feeling Chosen
experiences.source_premise: Create individualized menus of what helps when lonely, stressed, insecure, sad, or disconnected.

experiences.title: The Compliment You Can’t Dodge
experiences.part_title: Love, Affection, and Feeling Chosen
experiences.source_premise: Offer thoughtful compliments and practice receiving them without dismissal or deflection.

experiences.title: A Love Letter From the Future
experiences.part_title: Love, Affection, and Feeling Chosen
experiences.source_premise: Write letters from years ahead describing the love and qualities you hope endure.

experiences.title: The Everyday Devotion Experiment
experiences.part_title: Love, Affection, and Feeling Chosen
experiences.source_premise: Spend several days performing small, personally meaningful acts of affection and notice their effects.

experiences.title: The Attraction Interview
experiences.part_title: Desire, Attraction, and Sensual Intimacy
experiences.source_premise: Explore first attraction, current attraction, and how your understanding of chemistry has evolved.

experiences.title: The Yes, No, Maybe Game
experiences.part_title: Desire, Attraction, and Sensual Intimacy
experiences.source_premise: Individually classify romantic, affectionate, sensual, and sexual ideas as yes, no, or maybe; compare without pressure.

experiences.title: The Art of Anticipation
experiences.part_title: Desire, Attraction, and Sensual Intimacy
experiences.source_premise: Experiment with thoughtful messages, hints, and gestures leading to a mutually planned romantic experience.

experiences.title: The Sensory Date
experiences.part_title: Desire, Attraction, and Sensual Intimacy
experiences.source_premise: Create an experience based on music, scent, texture, taste, lighting, and welcome touch.

experiences.title: The Desire Nobody Asked About
experiences.part_title: Desire, Attraction, and Sensual Intimacy
experiences.source_premise: Discuss previously unexpressed wishes, fantasies, or forms of affection without obligations to act.

experiences.title: The Slow Dance With No Music
experiences.part_title: Desire, Attraction, and Sensual Intimacy
experiences.source_premise: Move together slowly in silence and explore unstructured closeness.

experiences.title: The Romantic Time Machine
experiences.part_title: Desire, Attraction, and Sensual Intimacy
experiences.source_premise: Imagine meeting in a different era or circumstance and what would still attract you.

experiences.title: The Intimacy Blueprint
experiences.part_title: Desire, Attraction, and Sensual Intimacy
experiences.source_premise: Map conditions that support romance and desire, what impedes them, and how to design for both partners.

experiences.title: Two Truths and a Beautiful Lie
experiences.part_title: Playfulness, Laughter, and a Little Mischief
experiences.source_premise: Tell two true personal stories and one convincing fiction; guess and uncover the truths.

experiences.title: Would You Rather: Unhinged Edition
experiences.part_title: Playfulness, Laughter, and a Little Mischief
experiences.source_premise: Choose between ludicrous, revealing, morally complicated, or romantic hypotheticals.

experiences.title: The Newlywed Game, Without the Wedding
experiences.part_title: Playfulness, Laughter, and a Little Mischief
experiences.source_premise: Privately answer trivia about your partner and compare knowledge, assumptions, and surprises.

experiences.title: The Ridiculous Role Reversal
experiences.part_title: Playfulness, Laughter, and a Little Mischief
experiences.source_premise: Lightheartedly impersonate each other, then discuss what is accurate or wildly wrong.

experiences.title: The Great Debate of Absolutely Nothing
experiences.part_title: Playfulness, Laughter, and a Little Mischief
experiences.source_premise: Argue opposite sides of entirely absurd propositions with exaggerated seriousness.

experiences.title: The Alternate Universe Couple
experiences.part_title: Playfulness, Laughter, and a Little Mischief
experiences.source_premise: Invent versions of yourselves in another world and imagine your meeting, attraction, and misadventures.

experiences.title: Truth, Dare, or Discover
experiences.part_title: Playfulness, Laughter, and a Little Mischief
experiences.source_premise: Use a three-mode game of revealing truths, funny dares, playful affection, and discovery.

experiences.title: The Secret Mission Exchange
experiences.part_title: Playfulness, Laughter, and a Little Mischief
experiences.source_premise: Assign each other private thoughtful, funny, or affectionate missions over several days.

experiences.title: The Life Not Taken
experiences.part_title: The Inner World: Dreams, Meaning, and Identity
experiences.source_premise: Consider alternate lives produced by different choices and the dreams still attached to them.

experiences.title: The Things That Make Life Worth Living
experiences.part_title: The Inner World: Dreams, Meaning, and Identity
experiences.source_premise: Discuss meaning, freedom, beauty, pleasure, contribution, and what makes life worthwhile.

experiences.title: The Unfinished Version of Me
experiences.part_title: The Inner World: Dreams, Meaning, and Identity
experiences.source_premise: Describe qualities you are still developing and mysteries you have not solved about yourself.

experiences.title: The Belief Beneath the Belief
experiences.part_title: The Inner World: Dreams, Meaning, and Identity
experiences.source_premise: Examine a conviction’s origins, why it matters, and what might change it.

experiences.title: If Nobody Were Watching
experiences.part_title: The Inner World: Dreams, Meaning, and Identity
experiences.source_premise: Imagine life without external judgment and what you would pursue, express, or abandon.

experiences.title: The Personal Mythology
experiences.part_title: The Inner World: Dreams, Meaning, and Identity
experiences.source_premise: Tell your life as a legend or novel with themes, characters, antagonists, twists, and unfinished chapters.

experiences.title: What I Want to Experience Before I Die
experiences.part_title: The Inner World: Dreams, Meaning, and Identity
experiences.source_premise: Share personal bucket lists, including ordinary pleasures and grand adventures.

experiences.title: The Questions Without Answers
experiences.part_title: The Inner World: Dreams, Meaning, and Identity
experiences.source_premise: Explore consciousness, mortality, love, morality, fate, and mystery without forcing agreement.

experiences.title: The Instruction Manual for My Bad Days
experiences.part_title: Trust, Communication, and Emotional Safety
experiences.source_premise: Describe how you act when distressed and what kinds of support help or worsen things.

experiences.title: What You Heard vs. What I Meant
experiences.part_title: Trust, Communication, and Emotional Safety
experiences.source_premise: Compare intended meaning with perceived meaning and practice checking interpretations.

experiences.title: The Gentle Disagreement
experiences.part_title: Trust, Communication, and Emotional Safety
experiences.source_premise: Work through a manageable disagreement with warmth, curiosity, and respect.

experiences.title: The Repair Shop
experiences.part_title: Trust, Communication, and Emotional Safety
experiences.source_premise: Revisit a minor misstep and practice acknowledgment, accountability, and repair instead of blame.

experiences.title: The Invisible Need
experiences.part_title: Trust, Communication, and Emotional Safety
experiences.source_premise: Identify needs that can emerge indirectly through withdrawal, jokes, frustration, or tension.

experiences.title: The Safety Map
experiences.part_title: Trust, Communication, and Emotional Safety
experiences.source_premise: Map actions, situations, and words that create emotional safety or guardedness.

experiences.title: The Appreciation Behind the Complaint
experiences.part_title: Trust, Communication, and Emotional Safety
experiences.source_premise: Translate a recurring minor irritation into an underlying wish and a constructive request.

experiences.title: The Trust Bank
experiences.part_title: Trust, Communication, and Emotional Safety
experiences.source_premise: Notice small actions that deposit into or withdraw from everyday trust over time.

experiences.title: The First-Time Challenge
experiences.part_title: Shared Adventures and New Experiences
experiences.source_premise: Try something neither person has done before and reflect on how novelty changes interaction.

experiences.title: The Twenty-Dollar Adventure
experiences.part_title: Shared Adventures and New Experiences
experiences.source_premise: Design a memorable experience with a very small budget using imagination and cooperation.

experiences.title: The Comfort Zone Exchange
experiences.part_title: Shared Adventures and New Experiences
experiences.source_premise: Introduce each other to a mutually acceptable unfamiliar activity.

experiences.title: The Night of Random Decisions
experiences.part_title: Shared Adventures and New Experiences
experiences.source_premise: Use dice, coins, or cards to choose between agreed options throughout an evening.

experiences.title: Build Something Together
experiences.part_title: Shared Adventures and New Experiences
experiences.source_premise: Make, cook, invent, or construct something and notice how you collaborate.

experiences.title: The World Through Your Eyes
experiences.part_title: Shared Adventures and New Experiences
experiences.source_premise: Each partner plans an experience around a deeply meaningful interest and explains its significance.

experiences.title: The Twelve-Hour Vacation
experiences.part_title: Shared Adventures and New Experiences
experiences.source_premise: Transform an ordinary day into an intentional miniature holiday or adventure.

experiences.title: The Shared Courage Experiment
experiences.part_title: Shared Adventures and New Experiences
experiences.source_premise: Face a manageable, mutually chosen challenge with encouragement and teamwork.

experiences.title: The First Chapter
experiences.part_title: The Past, the Present, and the Story of Us
experiences.source_premise: Reconstruct your early relationship separately, then compare impressions, uncertainties, and memories.

experiences.title: The Moments You Didn’t Know Mattered
experiences.part_title: The Past, the Present, and the Story of Us
experiences.source_premise: Reveal small gestures or words that mattered much more than your partner realized.

experiences.title: Our Greatest Hits
experiences.part_title: The Past, the Present, and the Story of Us
experiences.source_premise: Compile the funniest, most romantic, unexpected, and meaningful shared moments.

experiences.title: The Moment I Saw You Differently
experiences.part_title: The Past, the Present, and the Story of Us
experiences.source_premise: Recall a time your understanding of your partner fundamentally expanded.

experiences.title: The Relationship Timeline
experiences.part_title: The Past, the Present, and the Story of Us
experiences.source_premise: Map key moments, challenges, successes, changes, and turning points together.

experiences.title: The Unspoken Thank-You
experiences.part_title: The Past, the Present, and the Story of Us
experiences.source_premise: Recognize something meaningful your partner did that never received a full thank-you.

experiences.title: The Soundtrack of Us
experiences.part_title: The Past, the Present, and the Story of Us
experiences.source_premise: Choose music representing chapters or feelings in your shared history and tell its stories.

experiences.title: The Day Worth Reliving
experiences.part_title: The Past, the Present, and the Story of Us
experiences.source_premise: Each pick a shared day you would relive and reconstruct why it mattered.

experiences.title: The Forbidden Question Box
experiences.part_title: Radical Curiosity and the Surprising Stuff
experiences.source_premise: Privately contribute rarely asked questions, draw randomly, and freely pass when desired.

experiences.title: The Moral Gray Area
experiences.part_title: Radical Curiosity and the Surprising Stuff
experiences.source_premise: Discuss dilemmas with competing values and no obvious right answers.

experiences.title: The Secret Nobody Would Guess
experiences.part_title: Radical Curiosity and the Surprising Stuff
experiences.source_premise: Volunteer a surprising fact, experience, or thought that challenges assumptions.

experiences.title: The Dark Side of Me
experiences.part_title: Radical Curiosity and the Surprising Stuff
experiences.source_premise: Explore less flattering tendencies such as jealousy, vanity, resentment, or control with self-awareness.

experiences.title: What Would You Do If…?
experiences.part_title: Radical Curiosity and the Surprising Stuff
experiences.source_premise: Consider unexpected dilemmas about money, morality, relationships, and life-changing opportunities.

experiences.title: The Unpopular Opinion Club
experiences.part_title: Radical Curiosity and the Surprising Stuff
experiences.source_premise: Share underexpressed opinions and practice curious, noncompetitive disagreement.

experiences.title: The Question Behind the Question
experiences.part_title: Radical Curiosity and the Surprising Stuff
experiences.source_premise: Follow an ordinary answer with successive thoughtful questions revealing deeper meaning.

experiences.title: The Thing I’m Still Figuring Out
experiences.part_title: Radical Curiosity and the Surprising Stuff
experiences.source_premise: Share unresolved questions about self, life, intimacy, identity, or relationships.

experiences.title: The Relationship We Would Invent
experiences.part_title: Building a Closer Future Together
experiences.source_premise: Design relationship expectations and rituals from scratch rather than borrowing assumptions.

experiences.title: The Future Memory
experiences.part_title: Building a Closer Future Together
experiences.source_premise: Describe a happy future memory as if it already happened, then consider how to create it.

experiences.title: What We Want More Of
experiences.part_title: Building a Closer Future Together
experiences.source_premise: Identify experiences and actions you want to increase, not just problems to remove.

experiences.title: The Dream Exchange
experiences.part_title: Building a Closer Future Together
experiences.source_premise: Share individual ambitions and imagine support that respects each person’s ownership.

experiences.title: The Relationship Bucket List
experiences.part_title: Building a Closer Future Together
experiences.source_premise: Build a shared collection of adventures, traditions, achievements, and delightfully ridiculous goals.

experiences.title: The Annual Reintroduction
experiences.part_title: Building a Closer Future Together
experiences.source_premise: Return yearly to rediscover changing needs, interests, values, and wishes.

experiences.title: A Promise I Actually Want to Keep
experiences.part_title: Building a Closer Future Together
experiences.source_premise: Make a few realistic, meaningful relationship commitments with actionable follow-through.

experiences.title: The Next Chapter
experiences.part_title: Building a Closer Future Together
experiences.source_premise: Reflect on discoveries and design ongoing practices and future experiences together.

experiences.title: The Emotional Archaeologists
experiences.part_title: The Inventor’s Workshop: Original Proposals
experiences.source_premise: Investigate a powerful emotional reaction layer by layer without prematurely interpreting it; discover the need below the surface.

experiences.title: The One-Hundred-Year Interview
experiences.part_title: The Inventor’s Workshop: Original Proposals
experiences.source_premise: Interview each other as imagined centenarians and turn three invented memories into real-life aspirations.

experiences.title: The Invisible Postcards
experiences.part_title: The Inventor’s Workshop: Original Proposals
experiences.source_premise: Secretly collect short notes over days about moments your partner helped, impressed, or delighted you, then exchange them.

experiences.title: The Emotional Weather Report
experiences.part_title: The Inventor’s Workshop: Original Proposals
experiences.source_premise: Describe your inner state as a weather forecast, with an optional forecast of what may help tomorrow.

experiences.title: The Borrowed Brain Experiment
experiences.part_title: The Inventor’s Workshop: Original Proposals
experiences.source_premise: Answer a scenario as you think your partner would and compare the reasoning, not just the final decision.

experiences.title: The Museum of Unsaid Things
experiences.part_title: The Inventor’s Workshop: Original Proposals
experiences.source_premise: Create exhibit labels for thoughts, appreciation, fears, or needs left unsaid; pair 'what happened' with 'what I wish you understood.'

experiences.title: The Relationship Escape Room
experiences.part_title: The Inventor’s Workshop: Original Proposals
experiences.source_premise: Solve cooperative puzzles involving personal history, partner knowledge, and complementary skills.

experiences.title: The Two-Person Civilization
experiences.part_title: The Inventor’s Workshop: Original Proposals
experiences.source_premise: Invent a civilization’s founding principles together and adapt them when random events challenge your ideals.

experiences.title: The Compliment Decoder
experiences.part_title: The Inventor’s Workshop: Original Proposals
experiences.source_premise: Guess the lived story behind your partner’s deeper compliments before they disclose the actual source.

experiences.title: The Intimacy Negotiators
experiences.part_title: The Inventor’s Workshop: Original Proposals
experiences.source_premise: Allocate 100 imaginary points among forms of closeness and collaborate on a mutually appealing evening without demands.

experiences.title: The Memory Smuggler
experiences.part_title: The Inventor’s Workshop: Original Proposals
experiences.source_premise: Tell a true memory with one invented detail that symbolizes a wish, fear, or unrealized possibility; have the listener detect it.

experiences.title: The Secret Door
experiences.part_title: The Inventor’s Workshop: Original Proposals
experiences.source_premise: Use imaginary locked doors for inner-life themes; the person sharing controls which keys are offered and how deeply to explore.
